evidence.note: Static probe CONFIRMED the claim. Claim: the sole public definition in ddflow/api/lifecycle/planning.py missing from the package re-export is plan_for_offer (def at planning.py:72), so test_every_public_definition_an_area_makes_is_re_exported fails with 'lifecycle.plan_for_offer is not planning.plan_for_offer'. Probe: read planning.py (defines non-underscore top-level functions plan_for, plan_for_offer, alternatives_offer) and api/lifecycle/__init__.py:37 (imports only PURPOSES, alternatives_offer, plan_for from .planning). The layout test's _public_definitions() enumerates non-underscore FunctionDef/ClassDef in each area module and asserts getattr(LC,name) is getattr(mod,name); plan_for_offer is the single name where LC has no binding. Refutation would be: plan_for_offer already imported (it is not). Verdict CONFIRMED.

No recorded rule or decision forbids the change. The fix conforms to the layout guard the test enforces (tests/test_lifecycle_layout.py requires every public area definition re-exported). r-gemini-key-load applies to the review gates (key loaded before ddflow review). r-adapters/r-agent-parity/r-bounded-everything do not bear on a package __init__ re-export line.

One-line change: ddflow/api/lifecycle/__init__.py:37 now imports plan_for_offer alongside PURPOSES, alternatives_offer, plan_for. Committed 13d2cd795 on ddflow/fix-B0864b9309a (1 insertion, 1 deletion).
